notes: Data-driven governance configuration. governed_prefixes: directory prefixes whose change requires a matching semantic inventory record change (node anchor, interaction source/affected path, debt affected path, or a new protocol delta), or an active scoped waiver. The validator enforces a hardcoded floor on top of this file: the minimum product prefixes (backend/, frontend/src/, scenarios/) and the governance self-protection paths (workflow, this file, validator/, schemas/, tests/) can never be removed or waived here. required_interaction_categories: categories that must exist in critical-interactions.json. Editing this file is a protected-path change: it needs a kind=governance protocol delta.
